body:
I want to touch on the highly evolving efforts to run tests dedicated to the state - e.g. running tests against XEN on a recent mainnet snapshot - and to ask clients where they think their worst case behavior is (so we can write tests for this). For instance: updating existing slots in XEN, writing new slots to XEN, or deleting storage keys in XEN. 
Or: other more "exotic" tests like not targeting XEN only, but also the other big contracts on Mainnet (in the same block, possibly marking more state trie nodes as "dirty" which thus have to be updated before we can do the state root calculation).
Does someone have a recent overview of the biggest storage tries on mainnet?
